decision.explanation: The question asks when Judge Cummings was confirmed by the Senate. Two distinct dates appear in the sources: (1) D1S1 states confirmation occurred on 'December 8, 1987,' and (2) D2S8 states confirmation occurred on 'August 10' (year unspecified). Both are directly relevant and refer to the same subject ('Judge Cummings') and relation ('confirmed by the Senate'). Since neither source explicitly contradicts the other and both are validly attributed to the same entity, both are retained as separate valid answers.
